title: Active Life Assistant
description: Minor Project II. A health and activity companion that gathers sensor readings over IoT, uses machine learning to recognise movement and wellness patterns, and shows the results in a Flask web dashboard.
tagline: Turns raw sensor readings into movement and wellness insights.
goal: Activity trackers produce plenty of numbers but leave the interpretation to the user. This project closes that gap: sensor data is collected over IoT, a machine learning model recognises patterns in it, and a web dashboard presents the result in plain, readable form.

flow.title: Collect
flow.text: Sensors capture movement and activity readings and send them over IoT.

flow.title: Learn
flow.text: A machine learning model recognises movement and wellness patterns in the data.

flow.title: Serve
flow.text: A Flask backend receives the readings and prepares the results.

flow.title: Show
flow.text: The web dashboard presents the patterns so they can be read at a glance.

features.title: IoT data collection
features.text: Sensor readings are gathered over IoT instead of being entered by hand.

features.title: Pattern recognition
features.text: Machine learning identifies movement and wellness patterns in the readings.

features.title: Web dashboard
features.text: Results are shown in a Flask dashboard that works in any browser.

features.title: Wellness focus
features.text: The output is framed around activity and wellbeing, not raw numbers.

takeaways: Designing a system across hardware, a model and a web interface, not just one layer.
Presenting model output in a form non-technical users can act on.

title: Movie Review Web App
description: Minor Project I. A full-stack movie review platform where people can browse films and share reviews. React.js powers the interface, Spring Boot the backend and MongoDB the data.
tagline: Browse films, then say what you think.
goal: A review platform needs two things to feel alive: an easy way to find films and an easy way to say something about them. This project builds both as a full-stack application, with a React interface in front of a Spring Boot backend and a MongoDB database.

flow.title: Browse
flow.text: Visitors explore the film catalogue in the React interface.

flow.title: Open
flow.text: Selecting a film shows its details and the reviews so far.

flow.title: Review
flow.text: A visitor writes a review and submits it.

flow.title: Store
flow.text: Spring Boot receives the review and stores it in MongoDB, ready for the next visitor.

features.title: Film browsing
features.text: A catalogue of films that is quick to scan and easy to explore.

features.title: Shared reviews
features.text: Anyone can read what others think and add their own review.

features.title: Component-based UI
features.text: React.js builds the interface from small, reusable components.

features.title: Document storage
features.text: MongoDB keeps films and reviews as flexible documents.

takeaways: Connecting a React front end to a Java backend and a NoSQL database.
Structuring a full-stack app so each layer has one clear job.

title: Online Price Comparison
description: Learning Project II. Pulls product listings from online stores with web scraping and compares prices side by side, so the best deal is easy to spot. Built with Flask and MySQL.
tagline: Every store's price, side by side.
goal: Finding the best price usually means opening tab after tab. This project does the legwork: it pulls product listings from online stores with web scraping and lines them up so the best deal is easy to spot.

flow.title: Scrape
flow.text: Product listings are pulled from online stores with web scraping.

flow.title: Clean
flow.text: Names and prices are tidied into one consistent format.

flow.title: Store
flow.text: The results are saved in MySQL.

flow.title: Compare
flow.text: A Flask page shows the stores side by side, with the best deal easy to spot.

features.title: Automated collection
features.text: Listings are gathered by a scraper, not copied by hand.

features.title: Side-by-side comparison
features.text: Prices from different stores sit next to each other.

features.title: Best deal at a glance
features.text: The lowest price stands out without any digging.

features.title: Saved listings
features.text: MySQL stores the collected listings for comparison.

takeaways: Turning messy, differently formatted web data into something comparable.
Combining scraping, a database and a web app into one workflow.

title: ATM Simulator
description: Learning Project I. A web-based ATM simulation that mirrors the everyday flow of signing in, checking balances and making transactions, built with Java Server Pages and MySQL.
tagline: The familiar ATM routine, rebuilt for the browser.
goal: Everyone knows how an ATM behaves, which makes it a good way to practise application flow. This project reproduces the everyday routine of signing in, checking a balance and making transactions using Java Server Pages and MySQL.

flow.title: Sign in
flow.text: The user identifies themselves to start a session.

flow.title: Choose
flow.text: A menu offers balance checks and transactions.

flow.title: Transact
flow.text: The chosen operation runs and the balance changes accordingly.

flow.title: Record
flow.text: MySQL keeps the account data up to date.

features.title: Sign-in flow
features.text: Each session starts by identifying the account holder.

features.title: Balance checks
features.text: Current balances are one step away from the main menu.

features.title: Transactions
features.text: Transactions follow the order people expect from a real machine.

features.title: Persistent data
features.text: Account records live in MySQL, not in the page.

takeaways: Modelling a real-world process as clear, ordered screens.
Reading and writing database records from server-side Java.

title: TaskMaster: Task and Habit Tracker
description: Turn daily tasks into lasting habits with a structured three-phase system. Each phase lasts a few days to build consistency, and tasks can be added for any day or tied to a specific phase. Reminders keep every routine on track.
tagline: Turn daily tasks into lasting habits.
goal: Good intentions fade when there is no structure. TaskMaster gives routines a three-phase shape: each phase lasts a few days, so consistency builds step by step, and reminders keep every routine on track.

flow.title: Start
flow.text: Phase one begins the routine with a few days of repetition.

flow.title: Build
flow.text: Phase two builds consistency on top of that first foothold.

flow.title: Lock in
flow.text: Phase three turns the routine into a habit.

features.title: Three-phase system
features.text: A clear structure that makes progress visible from one phase to the next.

features.title: Flexible planning
features.text: Tasks can be added for any day, or tied to a specific phase.

features.title: Reminders
features.text: Notifications keep every routine on track.

features.title: Focused interface
features.text: A clean UI keeps attention on what needs doing today.

takeaways: Designing around a behaviour, habit formation, and not just a task list.
Using reminders to support a routine.

title: Music Streaming Interface
description: A Spotify-inspired front end that closely matches the original's interface and most of its features, built as a study in layout, audio playback and interaction design.
tagline: A close study of a familiar music player.
goal: Music apps look simple but pack in a lot of interaction. This front end recreates a Spotify-inspired interface, closely matching the original's layout and most of its features, as a study in layout, audio playback and interaction design.

features.title: Faithful layout
features.text: The structure of the interface closely matches the original's.

features.title: Audio playback
features.text: Playback controls drive real audio in the browser.

features.title: Interaction design
features.text: Controls respond the way listeners expect them to.

features.title: Feature coverage
features.text: Most of the original's features are reproduced, not just its look.

takeaways: Studying a polished interface closely to understand why it works.
Wiring audio playback to custom controls.

title: Creative Festival Design
description: An interactive celebration of Holi, the festival of colours, told through bold visual design and animation.
tagline: Holi in motion: colour, rhythm and play.
goal: Holi is about colour and joy, so the page had to feel the same. This interactive celebration uses bold visual design and animation to bring the festival of colours to the screen.

features.title: Bold colour
features.text: A vivid palette carries the spirit of the festival.

features.title: Animation
features.text: Motion gives the page the energy of the celebration itself.

features.title: Interactive
features.text: Visitors take part instead of just looking.

takeaways: Using animation to carry emotion, not just decoration.
Building a single-purpose page around one clear mood.

title: Regional Heritage Portal
description: A digital portal celebrating Utkal Divas and Odisha's heritage and cultural identity, designed to make the region's story easy and enjoyable to explore.
goal: Utkal Divas marks the identity of Odisha. This portal presents the region's heritage and culture in a way that is easy and enjoyable to explore.

features.title: Heritage content
features.text: Odisha's history and cultural identity are the heart of the portal.

features.title: Easy exploration
features.text: Visitors can find their own path through the material.

features.title: Designed for the subject
features.text: The visual design is shaped by the region's character.

takeaways: Designing around culture and content, not only features.
Organising rich material so visitors can explore it at their own pace.

title: National Celebration Hub
description: An interactive, responsive platform for national events and celebrations that looks as good on a phone as it does on a desktop.
goal: National events draw people on every kind of device. This platform is built to look as good on a phone as it does on a desktop, with interactive elements that make the celebration feel participatory.

features.title: Responsive by design
features.text: The layout adapts from phone to desktop without losing its polish.

features.title: Interactive elements
features.text: Visitors can engage with the celebration instead of only reading about it.

features.title: Event focus
features.text: Built around national events and celebrations.

takeaways: Designing interactions that work on touch screens and scale up to desktop.
Making one layout hold up across screen sizes.

title: All In One Search Hub
description: One starting point for the search engines you use every day. Open Google, Bing, Yahoo, DuckDuckGo and more from a single fast, simple interface instead of juggling separate sites.
tagline: Every search engine, one starting point.
goal: Switching between search engines means juggling separate sites. This hub puts Google, Bing, Yahoo, DuckDuckGo and more behind one fast, simple interface.

flow.title: Type
flow.text: Enter a query once.

flow.title: Pick
flow.text: Choose which search engine should answer it.

flow.title: Go
flow.text: The hub passes the query on and opens that engine's results.

features.title: One search box
features.text: A single place to start, whichever engine you prefer.

features.title: Many engines
features.text: Google, Bing, Yahoo, DuckDuckGo and more are one click apart.

features.title: Fast and simple
features.text: A light interface that gets out of the way.

features.title: CSS animation
features.text: Subtle motion makes the interface feel polished.

takeaways: Bringing several external services together behind one interface.
Using CSS animation for polish without slowing the page.

title: Open Source Contributions
description: A showcase of my open source work, including responsive templates and portfolio enhancements.
tagline: Small, useful contributions, shared in the open.
goal: Open source works when people share what they build. This collection showcases my contributions, including responsive templates and portfolio enhancements that others can reuse.

flow.title: Fork
flow.text: Copy the project so it can be changed freely.

flow.title: Change
flow.text: Make the improvement, such as a responsive layout or a reusable template.

flow.title: Propose
flow.text: Open a pull request to suggest the change to the original project.

flow.title: Merge
flow.text: Once reviewed and accepted, the change becomes part of the project.

features.title: Open collaboration
features.text: Work happens in public, alongside other contributors.

features.title: Reusable templates
features.text: Templates built so others can pick them up and adapt them.

features.title: Responsive by default
features.text: Layouts that hold up from phone to desktop.

features.title: Portfolio enhancements
features.text: Improvements aimed at personal portfolio sites.

takeaways: Working within other people's codebases and conventions.
Writing templates that others can pick up and reuse.

title: Basic Banking System
description: A web banking app built with PHP and MySQL. View customers, check account details and transfer money between accounts, with transaction history, user management and live balance updates. A responsive Bootstrap interface makes it a practical introduction to CRUD operations and PHP backend integration.
tagline: Customers, accounts and transfers in one tidy app.
goal: Banking is a classic way to learn CRUD. This PHP and MySQL app lets you view customers, check account details and move money between accounts, with transaction history, user management and live balance updates behind a responsive Bootstrap interface.

flow.title: View
flow.text: Browse the list of customers.

flow.title: Inspect
flow.text: Open an account to see its details and history.

flow.title: Transfer
flow.text: Choose a recipient and send money between accounts.

flow.title: Update
flow.text: Balances change immediately and the transfer is added to the transaction history.

features.title: Customer list
features.text: Every customer in one clear, scannable view.

features.title: Account details
features.text: Check an account's information without leaving the app.

features.title: Money transfers
features.text: Send money between accounts in a few steps.

features.title: Transaction history
features.text: Every transfer is recorded and can be looked back on.

features.title: User management
features.text: Add and maintain the people the system serves.

features.title: Live balances
features.text: Balances update as soon as a transaction completes.

takeaways: Practising CRUD operations end to end.
Keeping balances and history consistent when money moves.
